text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 115 units of gabapentin 100 mg capsules (NDC 72737000503) at 16.1 units per day, providing 7 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 82 units at 4.6 units per day, providing 18 days on hand. Corvale General holds 244.69 units at an implied rate giving 12.9 days on hand. All sites use the same NDC labeled by Stallion Laboratories Private Limited.

Why (FDA record): The label links to plant FEI 3013353854. FDA inspected the plant and classified it VAI on 2024-07-12. The inspection classification was known to FDA on 2024-09-28 per an FMD-145 letter. FDA’s drug shortage list does not include gabapentin as of 2026-10-21. No FDA record states that the VAI classification has led to shipping holds or allocation limits from this manufacturer.

Our position: East is below the two‑week target. Lakeside and General have sufficient stock to support a limited transfer. No shortage listing exists, so open‑market purchases from alternate suppliers are viable.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Purchase from Asclemed USA, Inc. (plant NAI 2025‑03‑05) — requires buyer approval.
3. Purchase from Proficient Rx LP (plant VAI 2022‑12‑08) — requires buyer approval.
4. Purchase from Westminster Pharmaceuticals, LLC (plant VAI 2024‑09‑05) — requires buyer approval.
5. Purchase from A‑S Medication Solutions (plant not identified) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying action while East remains at 7 days on hand; relying solely on the current Stallion supply without a contingency source.
